name: Nightmare War
description: War in which attackers from Krosa and the Cabal tried to kill Akroma.

description_citations.text: "Topos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A century after the Invasion the Mirari appears, starting wars that devastate the continent.
timeline.quote: A century after the Invasion, the Mirari appeared there, initiating a series of destructive wars that devastated much of the continent.

citation.text: "Otaria", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Nightmare War Akroma leads Ixidor's creations against the Cabal and Krosans until Phage releases deathwurms; Nivea's soul swallows Ixidor.
timeline.quote: The last deathwurm, the soul of Nivea, sought out Ixidor, swallowed him, and escaped as Akroma watched helplessly.

citation.text: "Akroma", section "Nightmare War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl defeats Phage and Akroma in a three-way battle; Akroma loses her legs, sparking the Nightmare War.
timeline.quote: ending with a victory for Kamahl and Akroma losing her legs, sparking off the Nightmare War .

citation.text: "Grand Coliseum", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl uses the powerful beasts in the Nightmare War, then returns to Krosa in defeat after his sister becomes Phage again.
timeline.quote: then returned to dwell in Krosa in defeat after his sister had once more become Phage

citation.text: "Krosa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Stonebrow serves as general of Kamahl's army at Aphetto and fights in the Nightmare War.
timeline.quote: Stonebrow served as the general of the strange army brought to Aphetto

citation.text: "Stonebrow", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Nightmare War, attackers charge Topos to kill Akroma; Ixidor creates sprites that conjure nightmares.
timeline.quote: Ixidor stopped them by creating disciples, tiny light-sprites that could enter their opponents' minds and create their worst nightmares.

citation.text: "Topos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
